changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
create or alter view graph.AssetNodeDetail WITH SCHEMABINDING as select ID, Uid, Class, AssetTypeID, AssetTypeUid, Path as KeyPath, Segments, State, UpdatedOn, graph.GetPath(Segments, ' > ', ' / ') as DisplayPath from graph.AssetNode GO
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_GraphAssetNodeDetail') BEGIN create unique clustered index CIX_GraphAssetNodeDetail on graph.AssetNodeDetail (ID) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_GraphAssetNodeDetail_DisplayPath') BEGIN create nonclustered index IX_GraphAssetNodeDetail_DisplayPath on graph.AssetNodeDetail (DisplayPath) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_GraphAssetNodeDetail_Uid') BEGIN create nonclustered index IX_GraphAssetNodeDetail_Uid on graph.AssetNodeDetail (Uid) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_GraphAssetNodeDetail_AssetType') BEGIN create nonclustered index IX_GraphAssetNodeDetail_AssetType on graph.AssetNodeDetail (AssetTypeID asc) END
